prompt: Your organization is looking to deploy a new email server solution. The primary requirement is to have a unified solution that integrates IMAP, POP3, and SMTP under the same server umbrella. One of your colleagues suggests using Courier. Why might the Courier server be a suitable choice?
choices: Courier is a unified mail server that integrates IMAP, POP3, and SMTP services
Courier is a mail filtering engine that only processes Sieve scripts
Courier is an SMTP-only relay with no mailbox access support
Courier is a webmail front end that depends on a separate mail server
explanation: Courier is a unified mail server that integrates IMAP, POP3, and SMTP services under a single server, making it suitable when a single integrated solution is required.
